So basicaly our project is about detecting food from a photo and telling how much calories it has. 
We started with the idea in second year when my roomate was trying to loose weight and he was writing everything in a notebook which was so boring that he stoped after one week lol. 
First we tried using a normal CNN classifier but it only gives one label for the whole image, and indian thali has like 5 or 6 things on one plate, so that didnt work at all. Then our guide sir told us to try YOLO, which can find many objects in one image. We had to make our own dataset becuase there was no good dataset for indian food, most of them are western like pizza burger etc. We took around 700 photos in canteen, mess and at home, and labeled them ourself using a tool called LabelImg which took forever honestly. The accuracy was very bad at first, around 40 percent, but after we added more pictures of dal and sabzi it improved alot.
 Calorie part is still not perfect because portion size is guessed.
